modal-dialog.modal-heading: I have a child’s Permanent Fund Dividend (PFD) from Alaska. Why can’t I report it in Direct File?

modal-content.p: The PFD is for . Because this amount is more than $1,300, a child’s PFD is taxable as unearned income.
Direct File doesn’t currently support reporting children’s unearned income.
You’ll need to file using another tool. You must report all of your income to the IRS, even if you’re not able to do so with Direct File.
Find other ways to file your federal taxes.

modal-dialog.modal-heading: Do I need to report my Permanent Fund Dividend (PFD) from Alaska if it’s garnished?

modal-content.p: Even if part or all of the PFD was garnished, the entire amount of the dividend must be reported as taxable income.

p.a: Learn more about tax reporting requirements for the PFD.

modal-content.p: Even if part or all of the PFD was garnished, the entire amount of the dividend must be reported as taxable income.

p.a: Learn more about tax reporting requirements for the PFD.

modal-dialog.modal-heading: What Form 1099-MISC income types aren’t yet supported in Direct File?

modal-content.p: In Direct File, you can report Form 1099-MISC as long as it’s the Alaska Permanent Fund Dividend (PFD).
The Form 1099-MISC is used to report many types of payments, but Direct File only supports the PFD payments listed in box 3 and any federal income tax withheld from the PFD in box 4.
Reporting other types of income requires filing additional forms and information that Direct File doesn’t currently support.
If you received money from any of these other sources, you’ll need to file using another tool.

modal-dialog.modal-heading: Why are we skipping other information on the Alaska Permanent Fund Dividend (PFD)?

modal-content.p: Your PFD reported on Form 1099-MISC may have additional information listed on it, but we don’t need those boxes to calculate your taxes.

Direct File only supports the standard deduction. If you want to take itemized deductions for withholdings related to any charitable, Alaska 529 Plan, or education raffle contributions, then you’ll need to file using another tool.
